issues.claim_boundary: Additive local same-source concurrency/resource experiment only. This is not the sanctioned five-cold/five-warm matched Windows/amd64 completion matrix and cannot close #9673 or the <=6,555 ms requirement.

quiescence.reason: Ten one-second pre-run samples had total CPU 1.934-6.793%, processor queue length 0 throughout, and 396 processes throughout; no system processes, security controls, services, priorities, affinity, or power settings were changed.

toolchain.note: GOTOOLCHAIN=local prevented a download or toolchain switch; each cold arm used a unique empty build cache while retaining the existing module download cache.

method.design: Full Cartesian 3x3 matrix: go build scheduling parallelism -p in {1,2,32} crossed with GOMAXPROCS in {1,2,32}. Three independently cold repetitions per cell, each followed by one warm no-source-change repetition reusing only that cell/repetition cache.

cache_definition.cold: new empty unique GOCACHE for the cell/repetition
cache_definition.warm: immediately repeated with identical source/argv/env and the same populated GOCACHE
cache_definition.gomodcache: existing read-only module-download inputs were reused; no dependency download was observed

measurement.cpu: go.exe TotalProcessorTime plus last sampled TotalProcessorTime for directly observed child processes; lower bound because short-lived children can exit between 100 ms polls
measurement.rss: maximum sampled sum of go.exe WorkingSet64 and direct-child WorkingSetSize at 100 ms cadence
measurement.process: maximum direct children of go.exe plus global process count
measurement.action: maximum concurrent direct child executable names compile/link/asm/cgo; go child count was also sampled
measurement.limitations: Windows process sampling was practical rather than kernel-accounted: CPU is explicitly a lower bound, RSS/process/action peaks may miss sub-100ms events, and descendants deeper than direct children were not separately walked.

adjudication.reason: The p=32/GOMAXPROCS=32 arm was stable and materially faster on this quiescent 32-logical-CPU workstation, but it peaked at 32 direct children and about 1.92 GiB sampled root+direct-child RSS. The CI safeguard was introduced for a fixed two-core hosted-runner process ceiling; this high-capacity local envelope does not supply that resource witness. The p=2/GOMAXPROCS=2 cold median was 72.447 s, slower than the historical 65.555 s clean baseline under a different source/toolchain, so this receipt also cannot justify changing CI.
adjudication.noise_rule: No faster arm was within noise relative to p=1/GOMAXPROCS=1 locally, but cross-host/resource-envelope mismatch controls the decision.

artifact.profile: plain go build development artifact; no -ldflags version stamp

stdout_lines: build: (no VCS stamp — built without module/VCS provenance; cannot confirm the commit)
smoke.identity_limit: The unstamped plain-go-build artifact reports dev/no VCS stamp. Identity is therefore bound by the clean source commit/tree recorded above plus byte-identical SHA-256, not by embedded BuildVersion.

provenance.collector: PowerShell 7 script generated in isolated %TEMP%; no repository source/config/system-setting mutation
provenance.raw_capture: raw-matrix.json retained in isolated scratch during this task; receipt contains every scalar sample needed for review
provenance.source_issue_assignment: Issue #9661 comment observed 2026-08-29: measure safe -p x GOMAXPROCS matrix around {1,2,available} on quiescent Windows and preserve -p=1 if alternatives are unstable or within noise.

limitations: Only three cold and three warm repetitions per matrix cell; this is an exploratory local matrix, not #9673's required 5+5 completion evidence.
This host has 16 physical/32 logical CPUs and 253.55 GiB RAM, not the fixed two-core hosted CI envelope named by #9661.
The source/toolchain are commit 092f3daf and Go 1.26.7, so comparisons to the historical 65,555 ms receipt (older source and Go 1.26.5) are contextual, not matched before/after claims.
No source edit/invalidation experiment was run; the assigned work was the concurrency/resource matrix.
No system security, service, priority, affinity, or power-plan setting was changed.
No claim is made that #9673 is complete or that the <=6,555 ms target is met.
